item.title: 🔵 Improving Smart Tiered Cache for Public Cloud Regions
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Smart Tiered Cache allows for precise upper tier selection for origins hosted on AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud with customer-provided cloud region hints.
